The Subtask Name: Determine the release date of Best Day Ever by Mac Miller
Agents:
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed previous result (Mac Miller identified) and decided to engage WebSurfer to find Best Day Ever release date.
  -- Observation: Performer is Mac Miller; need to find release date of Best Day Ever.
  -- Thought: Search for "Best Day Ever Mac Miller release date" and cross-check with reliable sources.
  -- Result: Decision to use WebSurfer with specific search instructions.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Searched for "Best Day Ever Mac Miller release date".
  -- Observation: Multiple sources (Wikipedia, Genius, Discogs) consistently state Best Day Ever was released on March 11, 2011. Wikipedia explicitly says "released by Rostrum Records on March 11, 2011".
  -- Thought: The release date is consistently March 11, 2011 across multiple reliable sources. The format is a mixtape.
  -- Result: Confirmed release date as March 11, 2011.
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed repeated WebSurfer results confirming March 11, 2011.
  -- Observation: Consistent agreement on date and format (mixtape) across Wikipedia, Genius, Discogs.
  -- Thought: The date is verified. Need to ensure final answer includes citations and notes on format.
  -- Result: Decision to proceed with final confirmation using Discogs and AllMusic if needed, but data already sufficient.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Accessed Discogs master page for Best Day Ever (URL: https://www.discogs.com/master/741526-Mac-Miller-Best-Day-Ever).
  -- Observation: Discogs page shows "Year: 2011" in JSON-LD metadata. Title is "Best Day Ever" by Mac Miller.
  -- Thought: Discogs confirms the year 2011, aligning with other sources. Specific day/month not explicitly in the visible JSON-LD snippet, but previous search results (Wikipedia/Genius) provided March 11.
  -- Result: Confirmed year 2011 on Discogs; combined with prior search results, full date is March 11, 2011.
